thread:
Amelia (Partnerships): Quick kickoff — we need to finish marketplace storefront onboarding for AWS/GCP/Azure. Target: staging listing by next Tue. Primary open items: IAM roles, trial SKU mapping, network egress, and localized T&Cs. Who can pick up creds and the network checklist?

Raj (Cloud Eng): I can take IAM and networking. Need the VPC egress requirements from GCP & Azure teams. Any constraints on egress IPs for marketplace validation?

Chris (Product): From PM side: trial SKU must match our trial limits (500k tokens/month free-tier). Also we need a short feature blurb and 2 screenshots for the storefront. I'll drop copy + screenshots by EOD.

Sophie (Legal): I'll start translations for FR/DE and surface any clause blockers. Question: do we need a separate EULA for private offers? Azure asked for a publisher-level agreement earlier.

Amelia (Partnerships): @Raj can you confirm if the marketplace validation requires static egress IPs? If so, Maya, can you allocate NATs?

Maya (DevOps): We can allocate NATs in AWS and Azure. GCP wants ranges — we can provide a /29 for staging. Need to know if the marketplace validation expects the publisher to call home during onboarding (yes/no).

Raj (Cloud Eng): Validation calls are outbound to vendor endpoints (license check + health pings). We'll whitelist the staging NATs. For GCP: staging-nat-1: 34.120.45.200/32 (example). For Azure I'll request IPs once I have the subscription ID.

Chris (Product): Also product packaging question: do we list a single SKU with tiered seats or separate SKUs per instance size? Partners PM at Azure suggested a single SKU + metering is easier. Thoughts?

Sophie (Legal): Single SKU is fine, but pricing/legal terms must call out metering and refund policy. I'll prepare a short clause: "Metered usage billed monthly; customer liable for metered charges during trial conversion." Need product approval.

Amelia (Partnerships): Good — @Chris please approve Sophie wording. Also we need AMI/VM image artifact paths for listing. Raj, can you confirm where the images will be hosted and whether they include checksum? The marketplace requires SHA256.

Raj (Cloud Eng): Images will be in S3 (private bucket until publish). I'll generate checksums. Example: s3://redwood-marketplace/images/rdw-inference-ubuntu-2026.img (sha256: abc123...placeholder). Will swap with real values when ready.

publisher-bot: Reminder: marketplace onboarding ticket #MP-492 created. Docs: https://internal.docs/redwood/marketplace/onboard (attached checklist).

Maya (DevOps): IAM roles: we need a publisher role for automated publish, and a reviewer role for staging. I'll put a minimal Terraform snippet for roles: 
```
resource "aws_iam_role" "marketplace_publisher" {
  name = "rdw-marketplace-publisher"
  assume_role_policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.pub-assume.json
}
```
I'll post the full TF in the ops channel.

Chris (Product): Copy for storefront: short blurb + 2 bullets + CTA. Sharing draft in #marketing in 10m.

Sophie (Legal): Azure private offer note: publisher account must accept legal addendum. Could delay launch by a week if the publisher portal team needs manual sign-off. Recommend we start that flow today.

Amelia (Partnerships): OK action items: (1) Raj: network egress IPs + checksums (owner), (2) Maya: TF IAM roles + NAT allocation (owner), (3) Sophie: EULA localization + private-offer clause (owner), (4) Chris: SKU packaging decision + storefront copy + screenshots (owner). Will run a 15 min sync tomorrow 09:30 PT. If any blocker before that, ping me. :thumbsup:

Raj (Cloud Eng): I'll drop IPs + checksums by 16:00 PT.

Maya (DevOps): TF snippet and NAT ticket created: OPS-201. Assigning to myself.

Sophie (Legal): Started translation ticket TR-88. Noted Azure private-offer risk.

Chris (Product): Screenshots + copy in 1 hour.

Amelia (Partnerships): Great — thanks team. If anyone gets a manual request from marketplace publisher support, forward to me.

publisher-bot: Ticket update: MP-492 status set to "in progress" by Amelia (Partnerships).
